cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Co-Sign This
cards.instruction: Get someone to help by making them an official participant who shares responsibility for the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I've made you co-organizer of Saturday's school trip. Can you approve the bus route?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only volunteered to drive. Your route misses the museum.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Good catch. Correct it and initial it; then we both own the plan.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll fix it, but you explain any delays to the parents.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Together. I'll introduce you as our transport lead and take the questions beside you.
